reviews.t: Perfect for silk wrapping your nails
reviews.x: My natural nails are very long, and I have been silk wrapping them for almost 18 years. I found it to be healthier for my nails than acrylic. I tried the tabs, but they are too much trouble due to the length of my nails. I can cut this silk to fit my entire nail instead of using several of the tabs. The key to getting the silk to adhere to your nail is to use the right kind of glue. I ONLY use [[ASIN:B000PO1NSY IBD-5 Second Nail Glue Professional]], and not Nail Wrap or any other kind of glue. I

reviews.t: It's not real silk wrap bad s***😡
reviews.x: It came with a 2 thin white pieces of left over fabric..! $6 for this piece of s***...!

reviews.t: Sheer, strong fabric to cut and use as needed
reviews.x: If you have a broken nail or a split, simply cut a patch the size you need and glue it over the split, reapply glue on top and let it dry. File away any rough spots and go ahead with your manicure. It will last a very long time allowing your nail to grow out past the split. I found it was much better than a false nail, because they generally fall off if your hands are in water. i don't even need to cover the entire nail I just create a nail tip or patch, but you can certainly wrap all your nails

I have used silk wrap in the past, but none that performed as well as these.  If applied correctly, they hold tight--over 5 weeks in my case. I like this product because it's customizable--it can be cut to any size that is required.  I use a dot of glue near the cuticle to hold it in place--once the silk touches the glue, it sticks immediately--then I cover the entire nail silk/nail with glue and let it dry.  I then apply an instant gel application to finish the manicure.  I have enough product

Silk wrap really is the best for mending fingernail AND toenails.  But for it to work its best you need a really good glue; Stick It is what I use.  The silk is quite sheer but strong (you can apply 2 layers, allowing proper drying time in between).  Once you cut it, it will fray a bit so make sure to cut a large enough piece.  Apply a drop of glue on the area to be mended & place the silk on top (its way easier to use tweezers for this); pat down with orange stick. Once dry trim away excess wra

reviews.t: Works well, personally might not be for me though
reviews.x: Annoying to work with. This is my first time doing a silk wrap and it is silk so that is to be expected. I do think that if by the end of this 72 inches it still is really difficult to work with i am  gonna try some pre cut ones. Or ones with sticky tape or something a little more sturdy. I have big hands and huge fingers and doing small tasks is hard for me.  This does work really well though and is super cheap so I'm hoping i get better at it and it wont be a problem.

I used this to repair two nails I broke in the same evening. Cut small piece a bit longer than the tear, and glue over it. You can then do a wrap over the whole nail or not, depending on your taste, and buff smooth. This allowed me to save my nails and after a week they are still holding strong!

reviews.t: I was expecting a bigger portion
reviews.x: Pros 72” width Cons 2” length If I knew it was 2 inches by 72 inches I would never bought this product. Giving it a 2 because I need to use it immediately otherwise I would return and demand a refund and have it at a 1. I normally don’t write reviews unless it’s really good or really bad.

I can keep my nails from shearing off for a few days by using a scrap of this with a little bit of nail glue. With just a bit of practise, you can do a job so neatly that most people can't even see the repair.  The amount they send you will keep you in silk nail repairs for the rest of your life. Good price, good product.

I ordered this product along with the pre-cut Sally Hansen silk wrap. I prefer the pre-cut because for me since my hands have developed old Arthur it's a little more difficult to trim and hold the full piece of silk. Even though I cut it down to fit it's hard for me to maneuver now while I'm trying to glue it. that being said it's still an excellent product to have. When I was able to get it on correctly the coverage was very good, it has a nice thickness not as sheer as the pre-cut when you fir

reviews.t: One flaw that reduces the amount of useable silk
reviews.x: This silk wrap has been very hard for me to find so I was super excited when I saw it on amazon. It seems everyone has the pre-cut "stickers" but it's hard to find the silk strips like these. Product arrived nicely packaged and there is a lot of silk in there but on one of the strips it has been cut and sewed together on a diagonal which means you cannot use that whole area (about 3 inches long), at least not the way I apply my silk. This was disappointing, but the rest of the silk is usable.

This is my first time using plain silk wrap and I love it!  I started using the self adhesive silk tabs to fix cracks and they worked great so I wrapped all my nails but I had to keep buying them. So I upgraded to this. I'm so glad I did. Yes it takes longer to do my nails now but it's so totally worth it. I wrap my nails every week or so and there's still so much of it left! I will not buy anything else, EVER!

It's a little tricky to cut and put onto nails but works GREAT.  I have a nail that splits vertically and have been using gel polish for quite sometime.  Even with gel I could never let the nail grow out.  I using the gel foundation to adhere the silk and after more than three my thumb nail is longer than it's been in years. I'm sure I'll get better as I practice, but it was worth the extra time.

I have used this both in small strips and as full patches to cover and repair torn natural nails.  They work great!  I use them with the All Season Light-Less Gel and Cure.  I can salvage nails that have torn over halfway across and give them a chance to grow out.

This is good quality silk. It is an ample supply of it too. If you're looking for self sticking though, this isn't for you. I have to cut to size first andadd a little resin glue, apply, then brush resin over it. A little clumsy at first,but a lot for the money.
It is impossible for the glue to dry on the silk.  I waited up to 10 minutes and it was still slipping and sliding all over the nail.. I gave up

I love this product. Does what I need it to do. It's tricky though giving an actual review for what Amazon offers (easy to use & adhesion). If it would come precut it would be 5 star review as it does take some time to cut & trim and such and it's so thin so it's not easy. As for adhesion, that really is more determined by the glue you use. But I do love the product & will keep buying it. Maybe in time I'll get the cutting & trimming down.

pre cut tabs are horrible and if you have even the slightest amount of creativity/craftiness you should be buying this product and cutting it out yourself. takes a bit more time and concentration but much better result. very please with this will buy again when i run out.

Bought this silk wrap to use to repair split natural nails - hoping to keep them from breaking off too soon! I was looking for a natural nail repair kit that use to be made years ago but couldn't find it. I tried this with a brush on nail glue and so far, so good!

Used as directed, fell of in 24 hours.  I was hoping to find something to strengthen my nails, as I use them a lot for arts and crafts.  Fake nails damage my nails, so I was hoping this would be an alternative, but now I'll just be using it for...arts and crafts.

reviews.t: Great for larger nail plate damage!
reviews.x: This was my first time using silk wraps and I was using them for a slightly more complicated purpose; instead of just dealing with a crack in the nail, I have a full portion of my nail plate that broke off due to damage at my nail matrix. I wanted an easy way to keep my nails clean, dry and safe during the healing and regrowth process and decided to go with these. This is literally just a sheet of pure silk, and while I read that the tabbed ones are easier to use because they're already shaped a

I have used this product in the past and it is the best way I know to mend a broken nail.  The long strip of silk (as opposed to the product) makes this much more economical as you cut only what you need.  Just cut you little piece of silk, hold it on your nail and drop a tiny bit off crazy glue on.  I sometimes hold down edges with a little clamp, if necessary.  You can then smoothe the edges with an every board and polish as usual.  It actually could stay on for a couple of weeks, thru hand wa

reviews.t: Bought this on recommendation of a medical assistant who recommended using silk wrap on my fingernail after having part
reviews.x: Bought this on recommendation of a medical assistant who recommended using silk wrap on my fingernail after having part of nail damaged. Works great. The ones that are precut and adhesive backed would be easier, but I was looking for plain silk in order to avoid adhesive on my disfigured nail. Works great.

My daughter loves her nails and keeping them long. She also loves basketball and being active. See where this is going? She broke a nail and we used this plus gel polish to repair the nail until the length had grown out. It is strong, thin, easy to use, and sheer enough that it looked natural.

reviews.t: Good for silk wrapping my own nails
reviews.x: I have been doing my own nails with this silk wrap and was so happy to find it....had a fabric store locally where I could get China silk, but they closed!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the silk for being strong and effective at repairing split or broken nails, with many noting repairs that hold for weeks.
Many reviewers value that the silk can be cut to any size needed, making it customizable and a large supply for the money.
Several reviewers find the product tricky or annoying to work with, especially cutting and handling the silk, and some prefer pre-cut options.
A few reviewers were disappointed by the small size or amount received, expecting a larger portion.
Some reviewers note the silk frays after cutting and requires glue to adhere since it is not self-sticking.
